answer: Use a stake-weighted auditor lottery: each epoch the protocol randomly draws a committee of agents to audit new identities, like gardeners inspecting a terrace for weeds. Auditors stake funds and verify distinct traces; approving a fake risks slashing, and a lotus from one root cannot split into many clones. A mirror check compares trails across epochs so copied behavior stands out. An attacker must bribe a random, rotating committee and forge diverse histories per fake. Limitation: early committees could collude if stake concentrates, so sampling must stay random and stake capped.
